text: {"lessons":["A few months of gains or losses do not establish a reliable trend, so I should avoid reacting to short-term fluctuations.","Selling Stock D after a large gain reduced my exposure, but I should base such decisions on my overall needs and portfolio balance, not the gain alone.","As a retiree relying on these savings, I should favor steady, cautious decisions and avoid frequent trading or taking risks I cannot afford."]}
